title.en: The One With the Water Lily

description.es: Marta y Fina hablan sobre Andrés en la tienda. Fina le dedica unos piropos maravillosos a Marta. Marta le dice a Fina que la necesita mucho y que vayan a su casa. Al principio Fina no quiere ir por culpa de los rumores, pero luego no puede resistirse a la insistencia de Marta.
description.en: Marta and Fina talk about Andrés at the store. Fina pays Marta wonderful compliments. Marta tells Fina that she needs her very much and that they should go to their home. At first Fina does not want to go because of the gossip, but then she cannot resist Marta's insistence.
